parameters.name: FileSystemId
parameters.description: The ID of the file system.

parameters.name: FileSystemType
parameters.description:
The type of the file system.

Valid value: extreme, which indicates Extreme File Storage NAS (NAS) file systems.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: SnapshotIds
parameters.description:
The snapshot IDs.

You can specify a maximum of 100 snapshot IDs. You must separate snapshot IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: SnapshotType
parameters.description:
The type of the snapshot.

Valid values:

*   auto: auto snapshot
*   user: manual snapshot
*   all (default): all snapshot types

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the snapshot.

Valid values:

*   progressing: The snapshot is being created.
*   accomplished: The snapshot is created.
*   failed: The snapshot fails to be created.
*   all (default): all snapshot states.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nas describe-snapshots --file-system-type extreme --file-system-id extreme-22f0000 --snapshot-ids s-extreme-67pxwk9aevrkr0000,s-extreme-snapsho0000,s-extreme-6tmsbas6ljhwh0000 --snapshot-name FinanceJoshua --snapshot-type all --status all --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun nas DescribeSnapshots --region cn-hangzhou --Status all --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --FileSystemType extreme --SnapshotIds 's-extreme-67pxwk9aevrkr0000,s-extreme-snapsho0000,s-extreme-6tmsbas6ljhwh0000' --FileSystemId 'extreme-22f0000' --SnapshotType all --SnapshotName FinanceJoshua
